Pause work without losing your place

In Workspace, add tasks in the order you want to do them. Push the queue when interrupted, or select a few tasks to push. You can add a reason afterward. Open the frame to edit tasks in place or restore all or selected tasks. Restore behavior in Settings decides where they go.

On Today, open the unscheduled queue. Drag a task onto a free part of the timeline or tap it to choose a time. Open a scheduled task to change or clear its time. Clearing a time does not remove the task from your queue.

Create a graph and add one node per step. Draw each arrow from a prerequisite to the step that needs it. Choose the goal and review the ordered steps. Add to queue appends those steps; Save as frame keeps them on the stack for later.

In Timetable, add a class manually or import a HUST schedule. Check the term, first Monday, weeks and periods in the preview before saving. Imported classes reserve time on Today. If campus sign-in is unavailable, choose an exported HUB week-array JSON file instead.

The planner works without a model. To chat, configure your service and key in Settings. Tapping Send contacts that service. Sharing other pages or notes requires permission; a proposed change does not alter your schedule until you review and apply it.
